WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS baseline1
  FROM telescope_avgs
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT ta.avg_pulse, fb.baseline1
  FROM telescope_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > fb.baseline1
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS baseline2
  FROM above_first
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT af.avg_pulse, af.baseline1, sb.baseline2
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb
  WHERE af.avg_pulse > sb.baseline2
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(avg_pulse - baseline1) AS mean_excess_first,
  AVG(avg_pulse - baseline2) AS mean_excess_second
FROM final_telescopes
